_quiet: Each earlier clearing of a site puts its next resettlement off by quieter more, up to quietMost times as long (Lairs.AfterDelve). After holdAfter clearings the site card suggests a tower and the stand-in builds one when it can. newMaster and newcomers are the boss line and room lines once something new moves in ({creature} is its master).
newMaster: the new master of the place
what moved in after the last company left
the {creature} that made the place its own
the old masters' hall, and a new thing on the throne
newcomers: a guard post that wasn't here before

watchers.text: Watches the gate and strikes the night your heroes march out.

tribute.text: Sends envoys to demand tribute first, and raids if refused.

newmoon.text: Comes only in the dark of the moon, heroes home or not.

bold.text: Raids in the open whenever it is ready, in bigger bands.
